fichas.title: Lecture Theatres
fichas.summary: Guidance and illustrated examples for lecture theatres of different capacities. Larger central lecture theatres are preferably placed in auditorium buildings, while smaller specialist theatres can be integrated into institute or seminar buildings. Access should be separated from research facilities and provide a short route from outside to the rear of the theatre. Lecturers enter from a preparation room; experiment benches should be movable, wheeled, and suitable for laboratory work. Media connections are required.
